name: Kouen no Shuryousha
source:
I am a sniper in the local park. My telephoto lens captures decisive moments with clarity. But up-close action is where the real joy lies. Yeah. I'm going to be a negotiator from now. Goodbye long-distance lens. Hello direct conversation and physical contact.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ063554.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
我是在当地公园活动的狙击手。我的长焦镜头能清晰捕捉决定性的瞬间。但真正的乐趣还是近距离行动。没错，从现在起，我要当一名谈判专家。再见了，远摄镜头；你好，面对面交谈和肢体接触。

[来源：[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ063554.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite英文版[/url]]
